causal_transition_implementation.state_input: candidate actual closed balance and its causal high-water mark only
causal_transition_implementation.activation_order: An admitted close first updates balance and drawdown; only then may it activate state, so its own position and close are never rescaled.
causal_transition_implementation.triggering_close_excluded_from_hold: Hold counting uses the state-active snapshot taken before transition; a newly triggering close therefore contributes zero.
causal_transition_implementation.future_birth_effect: A later birth observes active state and multiplies 0.01 * day multiplier * static weight before 0.01-lot rounding.
causal_transition_implementation.changed_birth_telemetry: A birth counts as changed only when its post-rounding target steps differ from the inactive static target.
causal_transition_implementation.release_order: A close that began with active state increments hold; release requires both the declared count and current drawdown at or below trigger minus hysteresis.
causal_transition_implementation.retrigger: After release, the same close cannot retrigger because the release threshold is strictly below the trigger; later accepted closes may retrigger.

frozen_selection.primary: positive development and both years, at least one trigger and post-rounding changed development birth, at least 80% exact-V8 development stressed net, actual DD at most 21.2%, and at least one point better than its own static seed
frozen_selection.fallback: same positivity/state-materiality, at least 75% exact-V8 development stressed net, and at least two points better than its own static seed
frozen_selection.robustness: at least four eligible immediate neighbors across three state axes within the same static seed
